## Theme submission

Change only your entry in `community.toml`: name, canonical github.com/codeberg.org repo_url, and positive integer theme_version/full commit pairs. Highest number is current. Never reuse a version number, even after removal.

- Theme slug and new theme_version:
- Exact commit:
- License and bundled asset attribution:

Maintainers document source/license review and browser acceptance (public + preview, DE + EN, desktop + mobile) here, tied to the exact commit and checker artifact. A green check is not human approval. Acceptance is the deliberate maintainer merge; no automatic merge.
